Package com.microservices.warehouse.storages.mappers

Class StorageMapper

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.warehouse.storages.mappers.StorageMapper
@Service public class StorageMapper extends Object
This class is responsible for mapping between the Storage entity, request, and response objects. It handles conversions for creating and updating storage records and mapping entity fields into corresponding response objects.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Pouria Ghafarbeigi

  • Method Details

    • toStorage

      public StorageEntity toStorage(StorageRequest storageRequest, UUID ownerId)
      Converts a StorageRequest object and owner ID into a StorageEntity. This method creates a new StorageEntity based on the request parameters such as category, dimensions, and amounts.
      Parameters:
      storageRequest - The request object containing storage details.
      ownerId - The ID of the storage's owner (UUID).
      Returns:
      A StorageEntity object representing the new storage record.
      Since:
      1.0

    • toStorage

      public StorageEntity toStorage(StorageRequest storageRequest, UUID ownerId, AddressEntity address, Long id)
      Converts a StorageRequest object, owner ID, and address entity into a StorageEntity. This method is used for updating an existing storage entity with additional information such as ID and address.
      Parameters:
      storageRequest - The request object containing updated storage details.
      ownerId - The ID of the storage's owner (UUID).
      address - The AddressEntity object representing the storage's location.
      id - The ID of the storage being updated.
      Returns:
      A StorageEntity object representing the updated storage record.
      Since:
      1.0

    • toResponse

      public StorageResponse toResponse(StorageEntity storage)
      Converts a StorageEntity object into a StorageResponse object. This method provides details such as ID, category, dimensions, amounts, address, and flags for the storage response.
      Parameters:
      storage - The StorageEntity object representing the storage record in the database.
      Returns:
      A StorageResponse object containing the details of the storage to be sent as a response.
      Since:
      1.0

    • convertStorageCategory

      public StorageCategoryEnum convertStorageCategory(String category)
      Converts a category string to the corresponding StorageCategoryEnum value. It throws a ConversionFailedException if the input string does not match a valid category.
      Parameters:
      category - The category string provided by the client.
      Returns:
      The corresponding StorageCategoryEnum value.
      Throws:
      org.springframework.core.convert.ConversionFailedException - If the category string is invalid.
      Since:
      1.0
